intake.description: Catch-all entry for novel requests no concrete workflow matched. Overlord scopes the bounded exploration or stops if illegible/unsafe.

explore.description: Overlord performs bounded, observable work by intent, obeying the mechanical safety rails. Pauses at user_checkpoint whenever a decision exceeds the bounded scope.

user_checkpoint.description: Stop for explicit user input whenever exploration reaches a decision beyond the bounded scope; this workflow leans on user gates rather than autonomous escalation.

report.description: Overlord delivers exploration results AND an ADVISORY recommendation on whether this request pattern should be codified into a new concrete workflow. This recommendation is advisory only — codification is a human decision (interrogation/ADR). This workflow NEVER auto-authors a workflow definition.
